themes.label: Rude or disrespectful staff
themes.definition: Staff were rude, disrespectful, sarcastic, humiliating or shouted at the client. It must describe how staff treated the client: generally poor or slow service ('lacks good customer service', 'improve your services') is not a signal and goes to other. Pressure during collection goes to coercive_collection.

themes.label: Coercive or harassing collection
themes.definition: Threats, harassment, repeated calls, undue pressure, seizing items, or contacting others to force repayment. Includes taking or selling the client's belongings to recover a loan.

themes.label: Public or embarrassing collection
themes.definition: Collection done in public or in groups in a way that shames the client or exposes their debt to others.

themes.label: No understanding in hardship
themes.definition: Staff or rules showed no understanding when the client was ill, bereaved or in hardship and could not pay on time.

themes.label: Misselling or unclear terms
themes.definition: The client was misled, promised something that did not happen, or not told the loan's conditions, fees or insurance when taking the loan.

themes.label: Unfair group liability
themes.definition: The client was made to pay for other group members or guarantors without that being explained.

themes.label: Unfair or selective treatment
themes.definition: The client felt distrusted, singled out, or refused a loan or service on grounds they see as unfair. Includes being refused a new loan after a late repayment.

themes.label: Complaint ignored or mishandled
themes.definition: A complaint or request the client raised was ignored, mishandled or never resolved.
